name: Helium 10
description: Helium 10 lets agents research Amazon products and keywords and read seller data with the signed-in Helium 10 account. Each user signs in to their own Helium 10 account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find high-volume keywords for a stainless steel water bottle on Amazon US.
Compare the top 10 listings for yoga mats by sales and reviews.
Draft a product title and five bullet points for my bamboo cutting board.

apps.name: Helium 10
apps.description: Product, keyword, and seller data access, over Helium 10's MCP server with browser sign-in.
